events.title: Tencent releases WeVisOne-VL weights for unified visual perception
events.title_zh: Tencent 发布 WeVisOne-VL 统一视觉感知权重
events.summary: Tencent released WeVisOne-VL 2B and 4B model weights plus a required 9.6M-parameter pixel decoder for detection, referring localization, counting, point grounding, OCR, segmentation and alpha matting. The Hugging Face repositories are ungated and list Apache-2.0, while the GitHub detector does not expose a detected license. Published benchmarks are vendor-reported.
events.summary_en: Tencent released WeVisOne-VL 2B and 4B model weights plus a required 9.6M-parameter pixel decoder for detection, referring localization, counting, point grounding, OCR, segmentation and alpha matting. The Hugging Face repositories are ungated and list Apache-2.0, while the GitHub detector does not expose a detected license. Published benchmarks are vendor-reported.
events.summary_zh: Tencent 公开 WeVisOne-VL 2B、4B 权重和必需的 960 万参数 pixel decoder，统一支持检测、指代表达定位、计数、point grounding、OCR、分割与 alpha matting。Hugging Face 仓库无需申请并标为 Apache-2.0，但 GitHub 尚未识别出许可证。公开 benchmark 均来自发布方。
events.why_it_matters: For teams that currently chain separate vision models, one open-weight interface may simplify experimentation and deployment. The broad task surface also raises evaluation risk: license notices, pixel-decoder packaging and accuracy on local images require independent checks.
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams that currently chain separate vision models, one open-weight interface may simplify experimentation and deployment. The broad task surface also raises evaluation risk: license notices, pixel-decoder packaging and accuracy on local images require independent checks.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对目前串联多个视觉模型的团队来说，统一的开放权重接口可能减少实验和部署复杂度。任务跨度很大也增加了评测风险：第三方许可、pixel decoder 打包和真实图片准确率都需要独立核对。

technical_details.tasks: open-vocabulary detection, referring localization, counting, point grounding, OCR, referring segmentation and alpha matting
technical_details.availability: ungated Hugging Face weights and public inference code
technical_details.license_boundary: model cards list Apache-2.0; GitHub license detector reports NOASSERTION, so inspect included third-party notices
technical_details.time_basis: public GitHub release commit at 2026-10-23T08:14:47Z; Hugging Face repositories expose date-only creation evidence

technical_details_zh.任务: 开放词汇检测、指代表达定位、计数、point grounding、OCR、指代分割、alpha matting
technical_details_zh.可用性: 无需申请的 Hugging Face 权重与公开推理代码
technical_details_zh.许可边界: model card 标为 Apache-2.0；GitHub 未识别出许可证，需核对第三方 notices
technical_details_zh.时间依据: GitHub 公开提交为 2026-10-23T08:14:47Z；Hugging Face 仓库只有日期精度

events.next_action_zh: 一天内用 30 张自有图片对比现有检测与分割链路，记录召回率、延迟、显存和第三方许可清单。
events.next_action_en: In one day, compare it with the current detection and segmentation pipeline on 30 local images, recording recall, latency, memory and third-party licenses.

evidence.claim_en: Tencent released WeVisOne-VL 2B/4B weights, the pixel decoder and inference code.
evidence.verification: public artifacts verified; benchmarks remain publisher-reported

events.title: Tencent releases Hy-Nomas for interactive world generation
events.title_zh: Tencent 发布交互式世界模型 Hy-Nomas
events.summary: Tencent released Hy-Nomas code, training recipes and open weights for multi-turn world generation controlled by text and camera movement. The project includes distilled 4-, 6- and 8-step variants and low-memory paths for a single RTX 4090. Its four-benchmark evaluation is publisher-reported, and no technical report is public.
events.summary_en: Tencent released Hy-Nomas code, training recipes and open weights for multi-turn world generation controlled by text and camera movement. The project includes distilled 4-, 6- and 8-step variants and low-memory paths for a single RTX 4090. Its four-benchmark evaluation is publisher-reported, and no technical report is public.
events.summary_zh: Tencent 公开 Hy-Nomas 代码、训练方案和权重，可用文本与镜头运动进行多轮世界生成。项目提供 4、6、8 步蒸馏版本，并给出单张 RTX 4090 的低显存路径。四项 benchmark 均由发布方评测，技术报告尚未公开。
events.why_it_matters: For teams prototyping interactive simulation or video agents, Hy-Nomas lowers the artifact barrier from a demo to runnable weights and code. The lack of an independent evaluation and technical report makes local temporal-consistency and control tests essential.
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams prototyping interactive simulation or video agents, Hy-Nomas lowers the artifact barrier from a demo to runnable weights and code. The lack of an independent evaluation and technical report makes local temporal-consistency and control tests essential.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对交互仿真或视频 agent 团队来说，Hy-Nomas 把门槛从演示降到可运行权重和代码。由于缺少独立评测与技术报告，仍需自行验证时序一致性和控制稳定性。

technical_details.architecture: segment-autoregressive diffusion transformer with persistent KV cache

technical_details.evaluation: four publisher-run benchmarks covering 280 cases; no independent evaluation

technical_details_zh.运行环境: 发布方提供单张 RTX 4090 的 INT8/FP8 低显存配置
technical_details_zh.评测边界: 四项发布方 benchmark，共 280 个测试样例；没有独立评测

events.next_action_en: In one day, reproduce a 10-second multi-turn camera-control sample, recording memory, latency, drift and license dependencies.

events.title: NVIDIA opens accuracy-aware tuning for TensorRT build routes
events.title_zh: NVIDIA 开放 TensorRT 精度约束调优
events.summary: NVIDIA released the TensorRT 11.1 Global Performance Tuner and an open-source trtexec implementation. It searches more than 200 compiler choices across build routes while treating accuracy as a constraint. NVIDIA reports 1.14x to 1.63x gains across ten workloads; independent reproduction is not yet available.
events.summary_en: NVIDIA released the TensorRT 11.1 Global Performance Tuner and an open-source trtexec implementation. It searches more than 200 compiler choices across build routes while treating accuracy as a constraint. NVIDIA reports 1.14x to 1.63x gains across ten workloads; independent reproduction is not yet available.
events.summary_zh: NVIDIA 在 TensorRT 11.1 发布 Global Performance Tuner，并开放 trtexec 实现。它把精度设为约束，在不同 build route 中搜索 200 多项编译选项。NVIDIA 报告十个工作负载获得 1.14 至 1.63 倍提升，尚无独立复现。
events.why_it_matters: For inference teams, this turns manual builder-route tuning into a repeatable search problem with an accuracy guard. Vendor-only performance numbers and search cost still require workload-specific validation.
events.why_it_matters_en: For inference teams, this turns manual builder-route tuning into a repeatable search problem with an accuracy guard. Vendor-only performance numbers and search cost still require workload-specific validation.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对推理团队来说，这把手工 build route 调优变成带精度护栏的可重复搜索。性能数字仍是厂商自报，搜索成本也需要用自有工作负载核算。

technical_details.search_space: more than 200 compiler knobs and multiple build routes
technical_details.metric_boundary: accuracy is a constraint; performance ranks valid configurations
technical_details.availability: open-source trtexec implementation; Python support planned for Torch-TensorRT 2.15
technical_details.time_basis: NVIDIA feed published Part 1 at 2026-10-23T17:27:35Z and Part 2 at 17:27:52Z

technical_details_zh.搜索空间: 200 多项编译选项与多条 build route
technical_details_zh.指标边界: 先用精度作约束，再按性能排序合格配置
technical_details_zh.发布方结果: 十个工作负载提升 1.14 至 1.63 倍
technical_details_zh.可用性: trtexec 开源实现已发布；Python 支持计划进入 Torch-TensorRT 2.15
technical_details_zh.时间依据: NVIDIA feed 中 Part 1 发布于 2026-10-23T17:27:35Z，Part 2 发布于 17:27:52Z

events.next_action_zh: 用一个生产 ONNX 模型跑现有配置与 tuner，对比精度、吞吐、构建时间和搜索成本。
events.next_action_en: Run one production ONNX model through the current build and the tuner, comparing accuracy, throughput, build time and search cost.

evidence.claim_zh: NVIDIA 已在 TensorRT 11.1 发布 Global Performance Tuner 和公开实现。
evidence.claim_en: NVIDIA released the Global Performance Tuner and public implementation in TensorRT 11.1.
evidence.verification: first-party release verified; performance gains are publisher-reported

events.title: Ai2 tests LitPivot for literature-grounded research pivots
events.title_zh: Ai2 测试用 LitPivot 改进文献驱动的研究转向
events.summary: Ai2 introduced LitPivot, a research prototype that organizes literature by facets and critiques developing ideas against nearby work. A within-subject study with 17 researchers found higher grounding ratings from two blinded domain experts than a text editor with AI assistance. A five-person follow-up explored longer-term use; no public code or service is available.
events.summary_en: Ai2 introduced LitPivot, a research prototype that organizes literature by facets and critiques developing ideas against nearby work. A within-subject study with 17 researchers found higher grounding ratings from two blinded domain experts than a text editor with AI assistance. A five-person follow-up explored longer-term use; no public code or service is available.
events.summary_zh: Ai2 介绍 LitPivot：它按研究切面整理文献，并用相邻工作批评正在形成的想法。17 名研究者参加了组内对照实验，两名盲评领域专家给出的文献扎根评分更高；另有 5 人参加长期跟踪。当前没有公开代码或可用服务。
events.why_it_matters: For research-tool builders, the study suggests that grounding support should be organized around claims and facets rather than generic chat. The small sample and unavailable artifact keep this at WATCH rather than a deployable recommendation.
events.why_it_matters_en: For research-tool builders, the study suggests that grounding support should be organized around claims and facets rather than generic chat. The small sample and unavailable artifact keep this at WATCH rather than a deployable recommendation.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对研究工具开发者来说，这项工作提示：文献支撑应围绕论点和研究切面组织，而不是只提供通用聊天。样本很小，且没有公开工具，因此只能继续观察。

technical_details.study: within-subject comparison with 17 researchers; two blinded domain experts rated grounding
technical_details.availability: paper and first-party article only; no public code or callable service

technical_details_zh.研究设计: 17 名研究者参加组内对照；两名盲评领域专家评价文献扎根程度
technical_details_zh.基线: 带 AI 辅助的文本编辑器
technical_details_zh.可用性: 只有论文和第一方文章，没有公开代码或可调用服务
technical_details_zh.时间依据: Hugging Face 官方 feed 发布时间为 2026-10-23T16:15:50Z

events.next_action_zh: 等公开代码、可试用系统或更大样本复现出现后，再评估是否进入研究工作流。
events.next_action_en: Reassess when public code, a usable system or a larger independent replication becomes available.

evidence.claim_zh: Ai2 报告 LitPivot 的小样本组内实验获得更高文献扎根评分。
evidence.claim_en: Ai2 reports higher literature-grounding ratings in a small within-subject LitPivot study.
evidence.verification: paper and first-party article verified; no public artifact or independent replication

events.title: Moonshot launches Kimi K3.1 Pro before releasing its weights
events.title_zh: Moonshot 上线 Kimi K3.1 Pro，权重仍待发布
events.summary: Moonshot launched Kimi K3.1 Pro and a Highspeed tier across Kimi, Kimi Work, Kimi Code and its API. The model has a one-million-token context window, while Highspeed is advertised at two to three times the serving speed. Full weights are promised by November 4 but are not yet available; benchmark claims are publisher-reported.
events.summary_en: Moonshot launched Kimi K3.1 Pro and a Highspeed tier across Kimi, Kimi Work, Kimi Code and its API. The model has a one-million-token context window, while Highspeed is advertised at two to three times the serving speed. Full weights are promised by November 4 but are not yet available; benchmark claims are publisher-reported.
events.summary_zh: Moonshot 已在 Kimi、Kimi Work、Kimi Code 和 API 上线 Kimi K3.1 Pro 与 Highspeed 版本。模型上下文窗口为 100 万 token，Highspeed 宣称推理速度快 2 至 3 倍。完整权重承诺在 11 月 4 日前发布，但当前尚不可下载；benchmark 均由发布方报告。
events.why_it_matters: For coding and long-context teams, the callable API enables immediate evaluation and the promised weights could materially widen deployment options. Availability and performance must be kept separate: the API is live, but the open weights and independent benchmark runs are not.
events.why_it_matters_en: For coding and long-context teams, the callable API enables immediate evaluation and the promised weights could materially widen deployment options. Availability and performance must be kept separate: the API is live, but the open weights and independent benchmark runs are not.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对 coding 和长上下文团队来说，可调用 API 已经能做对照测试，后续权重可能进一步扩大部署选择。必须区分可用性和性能：API 已上线，开放权重与独立 benchmark 复现尚未出现。

events.title: Block previews Dessa, a speech-only full-duplex conversation model
events.title_zh: Block 预览纯语音训练的全双工模型 Dessa
events.summary: Block previewed Dessa, a speech-to-speech model trained from scratch on human conversation without text or a pretrained model. It listens and speaks simultaneously and runs faster than real time, according to the team. The page provides selected audio demonstrations but no weights, code, API, benchmark protocol or independent evaluation.
events.summary_en: Block previewed Dessa, a speech-to-speech model trained from scratch on human conversation without text or a pretrained model. It listens and speaks simultaneously and runs faster than real time, according to the team. The page provides selected audio demonstrations but no weights, code, API, benchmark protocol or independent evaluation.
events.summary_zh: Block 预览 Dessa：一个从人类对话语音开始训练、未使用文本或预训练模型的 speech-to-speech 模型。团队称它能同时听和说，推理快于实时。页面只提供精选音频演示，没有权重、代码、API、benchmark 协议或独立评测。
events.why_it_matters: For voice-agent builders, speech-only training could preserve timing, overlap and emotion that text intermediates discard. Without a testable artifact or systematic evaluation, the demo cannot yet support an architecture decision.
events.why_it_matters_en: For voice-agent builders, speech-only training could preserve timing, overlap and emotion that text intermediates discard. Without a testable artifact or systematic evaluation, the demo cannot yet support an architecture decision.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对语音 agent 开发者来说，纯语音训练可能保留文本中间层丢失的节奏、重叠发言和情绪。没有可测试产物或系统评测，当前演示还不足以支撑架构决策。
